t: President Droupadi Murmu reshuffled Governors in six states on 12 October 2026: Om Prakash Mathur (till then Governor of Sikkim) became Governor of Keralam, outgoing Keralam Governor Rajendra Vishwanath Arlekar moved to Tamil Nadu, and Dushyant Gautam (Sikkim), Braj Mohan Ram (Odisha), Dr. Sudha Yadav (Karnataka) and Dr. Dhal Singh Bisen (Uttarakhand) were appointed.

Prakash Rajpurohit, a 2010-batch IAS officer of the Rajasthan cadre, was appointed Deputy Election Commissioner in the Election Commission of India with tenure up to 8 April 2030, replacing Sanjay Kumar.
Indian Navy frigate INS Trishul arrived at Plymouth, United Kingdom, for KONKAN-26, the bilateral maritime exercise between the Indian Navy and the Royal Navy.

India hosted the first BIMSTEC Home Ministers' Meeting in New Delhi on 13 October 2026, chaired by Union Home Minister Amit Shah, on cooperation against terrorism, transnational organised crime, narcotics and cyber threats among the seven BIMSTEC members.

The PM GatiShakti National Master Plan for multimodal infrastructure completed five years on 13 October 2026 (launched 13 October 2021); its stated aim is to cut logistics costs from 13-14% to 8-9% of GDP.
